topic: Second Together training run (V2, bundled fixes) launched, completed, and A/B tested against V1 on matched prompt pairs
authorization: Owner directive: max 5 Together runs total, 1 used (diagnostic run). This is run 2 of 5 (2 used, 3 remain). Bundled all identified fixes into ONE run per owner instruction, rather than testing them separately.

run.config: same as run 1 (model=Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B, from_hf_model=huihui-ai/Huihui-Qwen3.5-0.8B-abliterated@4813135658fe51b2e535b8e77927d2f23909ce42, lora r=64 alpha=128, n_epochs=1, learning_rate=1e-5) -- only the training DATA changed, so this is a clean isolated comparison of the fix, not a confound of hyperparameters too.
run.dataset: 9544 rows, same composition/size as run 1 (7 of 16 families patched, 9 unchanged) -- research_entity/claycode/training/*_V2.jsonl, built by tools/trigger2_v2_prompt_fix_patch_20260827.py
run.fix_wording_source: ~/last-resort/llm.py pool (Groq tier this call) proposed the vocabulary swap and instruction wording; reviewed and applied deterministically via regex/string substitution (tools/trigger2_v2_prompt_fix_patch_20260827.py), not pasted in blind -- e.g. the tool's suggestion to also rename 'atom'->'SYMBOL' throughout was NOT applied, since that would have broken the actual required output token format.

ab_test.method: 125 matched prompt pairs: for each of the 7 patched families, 15 fresh real HOLDOUT_FROZEN rows (10 for the 2 unpatched control families), each tested against BOTH the original V1 prompt wording (fed to the V1 adapter) and the patched V2 prompt wording (fed to the V2 adapter) -- same base model, same rows, same expected answers, only the adapter+prompt-version differs. Both adapters loaded into the same base process via peft multi-adapter (set_adapter), not two separate model loads, so this is an exact apples-to-apples comparison, not two independent runs with different sampling noise sources.

B0_WRITE_BASELINE (control, unpatched).verdict: unchanged, as expected -- no regression on a control family

B1_TRAIN_BALANCED_2ORDER.verdict: no meaningful change -- generic format-reminder fix did not help this family

B2_MID_EPISODE_REMAP.verdict: FORMAT FIXED (3->15 valid) but correctness unchanged (still 0) -- the model now reliably emits a real trained atom, but still not the right one for this task

B2_PRIOR_OVERRIDE.verdict: REGRESSED on the shell's strict check, but the underlying cause is understood and is itself informative, not a mystery -- see below

B3_MULTI_HOP_DEREF.verdict: MAJOR FORMAT FIX (0->15 valid, the code-derailment is completely gone) plus real correctness gain (0->2)

B3_UNRESOLVABLE_CHAIN_REJECTION.verdict: MAJOR FORMAT FIX (0->12 valid) plus real correctness gain (0->4)

B4_CAPACITY_INTERFERENCE.verdict: BEST RESULT: total collapse to 87% correct (13/15). The explicit format-wrapper instruction completely solved this family.

B5_VARIABLE_N_EQUIVARIANCE.verdict: NO CHANGE -- the same instruction that fixed B4 did not fix B5, despite both getting the identical suffix wording. Open question, not yet explained by this pass.

b2_prior_override_regression_explained.finding: V1's codebook-key-leak bug (answering ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN) is GONE in V2 -- the fix instruction worked at the semantic level. But V2 now outputs a bare number ('12', '13') instead of the required 'ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL:12' wrapper -- the second example above got the exact CORRECT number (13) but fails shell validation purely on format. Root cause: the fix instruction said 'answer with ONLY the mapped ordinal value', which the model reasonably read as 'just the number', dropping the ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL: prefix it never explicitly asked to keep. This is a one-line wording bug in the fix itself, not a deeper problem -- a corrected version of this specific instruction ('...respond with the full ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL:<n> token for that value, not the bare number and not the class name') is the natural next micro-fix, not evidence the underlying approach failed.

honest_overall_verdict: Real, substantial improvement from one bundled fix pass: correct rate roughly TRIPLED (7.2% -> 22.4%) on the exact families targeted, with B4 going from complete collapse to 87% correct and both B3 variants going from 0% format compliance to majority format compliance plus new nonzero correctness. Not a uniform win: B1, B5, and B2_MID_EPISODE_REMAP's correctness did not move (though B2_MID_EPISODE_REMAP's format did), and B2_PRIOR_OVERRIDE's specific fix wording has an identified, fixable format bug of its own. This is exactly the kind of result a single honest diagnostic-and-fix cycle should produce -- clear wins, one clear miss with a known cause, two genuinely unexplained non-movers -- not oversold as 'solved'.
runs_used: 2 of 5 authorized Together runs now used. 3 remain. Recommendation if a 3rd run is ever undertaken: fix the B2_PRIOR_OVERRIDE instruction wording (require the full ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL: prefix explicitly) and investigate why B5's identical-wording fix had zero effect before spending another run -- bundle those two investigations into one well-prepared pass rather than two more piecemeal runs, per the same owner directive.
